entry.title: 疏散避難

sender.value: 花蓮縣消防局

entry.text: [疏散避難]萬里溪堰塞湖目前穩定溢流仍存在有不確定性風險，請勿進入萬里溪堤防周邊及河床等縣府公告警戒區，違者將依災害防救法舉發裁罰。 [Evacuation and Shelter]The Wanli Stream landslide-dammed lake is currently experiencing stable overflow; however, residual uncertainties and potential risks remain. Members of the public are advised not to enter the county government-designated alert zones, including areas surrounding the Wanli Stream embankment and riverbed. Violators will be reported and subject to penalties in accordance with the Disaster Prevention and Protection Act. https://www.hl.gov.tw/kra/.Hualien County EOC03-8462119

entry.title: 疏散避難

sender.value: 花蓮縣消防局

entry.text: [疏散避難]萬里溪堰塞湖目前穩定溢流仍存在有不確定性風險，請勿進入萬里溪堤防周邊及河床等縣府公告警戒區，違者將依災害防救法舉發裁罰。 [Evacuation and Shelter]The Wanli Stream landslide-dammed lake is currently experiencing stable overflow; however, residual uncertainties and potential risks remain. Members of the public are advised not to enter the county government-designated alert zones, including areas surrounding the Wanli Stream embankment and riverbed. Violators will be reported and subject to penalties in accordance with the Disaster Prevention and Protection Act. https://www.hl.gov.tw/kra/.Hualien County EOC03-8462119

entry.text: [疏散避難]萬里溪堰塞湖目前穩定溢流仍存在有不確定性風險，請勿進入萬里溪堤防周邊及河床等縣府公告警戒區，違者將依災害防救法舉發裁罰。 [Evacuation and Shelter]The Wanli Stream landslide-dammed lake is currently experiencing stable overflow; however, residual uncertainties and potential risks remain. Violators will be reported and subject to penalties in accordance with the Disaster Prevention and Protection Act. https://www.hl.gov.tw/kra/.Hualien County EOC03-8462119
